system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your ability to subtly magnify objects, structures and creatures have grown to the point where you can manipulate those magnified, in subtle ways.

At the beginning of each of your turns, and once per turn when you cast a Jiton Hijutsu, you accumulate a Magnetic Charge, of which you can have up to 4 at any given time. These Magnetic Charges last for 1 minute. Once per turn, you can spend your Magnetic Charges to manipulate objects, structures and creatures in certain ways. If your Magnetic Tag requires a saving throw, it uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Magnetic Pulse. When a metallic weapon is used as part of an attack while within range, you can spend 1 tag, to impose a 1d4 penalty to the attack result. This increases to 1d6 at 11th level.

Magnetic Shield. When a metallic weapon is used as part of an attack while within range, you can spend 1 tag, to reduce the damage die size of the weapon by 1 step. If the weapons damage rolls multiple dice, you instead reduce the number of dice rolled by 1. Reduce the damage die size by one additional step at 7th and 15th levels. If the weapons damage die is a d4 and cannot be reduced any further, they instead treat their dice result as 1.

Magnetic Snatch. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 tag to attempt to snatch a weapon held by an unwilling creature in range. They must make a Strength saving throw, having their weapon taken from them and pulled to you, on a failed save. Increase the number of creatures you can target by +1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Magnetic Vectors. When a metallic weapon is used as part of a ranged attack while within range, you can spend 2 tags and your reaction to redirect the attack to another creature within range. Make a jutsu attack, using your highest bonus against the new target. On a hit, apply the attacks original effect to the new target.

Magnetic Puppetry. As an Action, select a creature you can see wielding a metallic weapon and spend 3 tags to force them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, you control the weapon they are wielding, as it seemingly comes to life in their hands as it strikes out against a creature within 5 feet of them. The creature that failed their save must make an attack against the closest creature to them of your choice, dealing their attacks damage + 2d8. Increase the bonus damage by +1d8 and the number of creatures you can target by +1 at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.
